bibliographic.title: Tlaotl
bibliographic.author: The SurvivalVis
bibliographic.description:
A small choose your own adventure styled text game mixed with a bit of TellTale Games' means of a narrative coming together at certain points. Live a life among the ancient and unchanging world of Tlaotl, a village in harmony with its finite surroundings which has survived for hundreds of generations. Explore many different roles and routes through your life among the village and also discover something that could threaten to bring an unknown chaos to the village; change.

*There will be some spelling errors that are being worked and corrected as this is its first public release.
